diagnosis: The V2-08 orchestrator converted every thrown transport error into ACK_UNKNOWN. A just-created endpoint health failure therefore became indistinguishable from an ambiguous POST, while RunPod has no request-key job lookup. The exact original health error was erased and cannot be proven retrospectively.
repair: Only V2-08 policy dispatch receives a bounded startup-health propagation window. Only terminal HTTP read failure is retried; transport ambiguity, auth, malformed response, abort, and nonempty queue fail immediately. Pre-POST errors now propagate unchanged. The RunPod POST remains single-attempt and only its ambiguous result becomes ACK_UNKNOWN.
next_boundary: Fresh exact single-use approval is required for the repaired source. No authority reuse or redispatch is permitted.
